_comment: GOLDEN 2026-07-29 LONG RUN — full 305-station GPS+Galileo all-on, 30 s cadence,
3 h (360 epochs), COLD start at 00:00:00 GPS on DOY-129 (2024-05-08).
PURPOSE.  The _golden0729_* family standardized the armed set after an audit found
many validated implementations were being left out of network configs by accident
(the arm set now lives in ONE place, _golden0729_allon_delta.json, and every roster
config composes it via 'extends').  Every arm of that set has so far only been
exercised at 10-30 epochs, which is inside the cold-start ignition transient — a
window in which nothing may be graded (project_net305_attribution_rerun: 'never
verdict inside ignition').  This config is the first run long enough to read
CONVERGENCE and STABILITY of the standardized posture at full network scale.
PROVENANCE.  Extends _golden0729_net305_30ep.json verbatim — same 305-station
roster, same clock datum (MBAR00UGA), same carry/datum posture, same arm set — and
changes only (a) max_duration_s 900 -> 10800, (b) output/log destinations, (c) three
extra cheap traces, (d) periodic state snapshots.  NO estimation knob differs from
the 30-epoch golden arm, so the first 30 epochs of this run are directly comparable
to it.
GRADING (datum-invariant / SD only — standing invariant #5).  Primary:
network_epoch_status.csv emitted-vs-withheld and postfit sigma0 trend; run-end
counters from the teardown readout (standing invariant #4 — '0 driven / 0 folded'
means the wiring is inert regardless of how clean the log looks).  Secondary:
network_dd_fractional.csv DD-chord convergence, network_sh_spectrum.csv ev1 /
a00 LEVEL (never slope — project_gg305_warm_resume_chain), network_solution.csv
clock + code-bias level stability, network_if_slip.csv / network_d5_flags.csv slip
churn, network_zwd.csv troposphere stability.
WATCH ITEM — sh_health_gate has no release/degrade policy: a sick-field era
withholds the wire for its full duration (95+ min measured on DOY-129).  The a00
band is already demoted to the ruled wide backstop rail [-60, +200] with
sh_gate_min_epochs = 10 so the cold-start transient is not gated as a fault, but a
long withhold stretch in network_epoch_status.csv is the expected failure signature,
not a crash.
ONE INHERITED DEFECT FIXED.  The roster base pins emit_pb_filter_jump_k = 8.0, which
is the RETIRED v1 hand tuning: the gate_v2 card (33x/178x measured improvement, gates
G1-G5 pass) replaced it with the k = 4.0 code default, and the promotion ledger names
jump_k=8 + meas_sigma_m=0.1 as the two v1 values 160 of 180 emit_pb_filter configs
still carry.  The runtime POSTURE check flags it as a SCOPED gap.  Overridden to 4.0
here.  Safe: emit_pb_filter and all its sub-knobs are OUTPUTS-ONLY and are NOT in the
warm-resume fingerprint, and the PB filter lives in the emission frame only — never in
the estimator — so this cannot perturb the estimation health read this run exists for.
SNAPSHOTS.  state_snapshot_* is write-only in the forward pass (insurance against
losing a multi-hour run, plus a warm-resume seed for follow-on legs).  Diagonal carry
blob (committed dee2824) keeps each snapshot ~0.6 MB instead of ~258 MB.
THREADS.  eigen_threads / parallel_max_threads held at 10 exactly as in the 30-epoch
arm: this box has 20 logical cores and a concurrent producer run was holding 8 of
them at launch.  parallel_carry ON / parallel_reduce OFF is inherited (they are
mutually exclusive — the loader silently forces pcarry off if both are set).
